snippet.title: Sonic SpeedStars BETA v1.1 - Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD LINK:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DomEj6x53tGMAf2Eeob6OVJqD1dVI2o-?usp=sharing

WARNING: This fan-made game should NOT be sold. All registered trademarks and copyrights belong to SEGA® and SONIC TEAM™.

Sonic SpeedStars is a high-speed action platformer that uses character specific abilities to clear stages.

Sonic SpeedStars BETA v1.1 includes 
3 playable characters - Sonic the Hedgehog, Miles “Tails” Prower and Knuckles the Echidna.
Tutorial Stage - TutorialZone act Sonic.
3 Main Stages - GeoPalaceZone act 1, 2 and 3.
Boss Fight Stage - The EggGuster.
A Menu System.
A Title Screen.
Xbox Gamepad Controller Support.

CREDITS: All background music belong to the respective owners 

TutorialZone act Sonic:
Sonic Frontiers The Final Horizon Mock OST - Cyberspace I Got A Feeling: https://youtu.be/vvUmby-aeWk?si=E_ViKcOHc_9gOrXr

rosy: https://youtube.com/@yinshon?si=5rEvLvp93x3GN3_e

GeoPalaceZone act 1:
Windmill Isle act 2 Day - Sonic Unleashed

GeoPalaceZone act 2:
Spring Emotions - Sonic Runners

GeoPalaceZone act 3:
Power Ride - Sonic Runners

Boss Fight Zone:
[TNH Nebula] Superstar Delusions Sonic Superstars UNOFFICIAL TRACK (MASTERED Ver.):
https://youtu.be/8-hckP1vpEs?si=B_ISEgdphxwfLkS7

TNH Nebula:
https://youtube.com/@TnhGameRemixes?si=eDO4HoVkyA68jarZ

Main Menu:
Sonic Advance 3 - Sonic Factory Remix - Silent Dreams: https://youtube.com/@SilentDreamsMax?si=3ywp0OqRdsWJ4JXH

Title Screen:
Opening/ Ex Demo 2 (Sonic Advance 3) Remix: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLraDZqONZ1Kxjv9Sm9FdgMQWfLUQn1oXd&si=J1P1RN0Jf4RxMqgp

Techno Cinema: https://youtube.com/@TechnoCinemaMusic?si=ePOdoJRsQ32b-NKF

Some character, enemies and object sprites were used from Sprite Resources.com: https://www.spriters-resource.com/

This Framework was made in the Unity Engine from the ground up.

Thank you for reading this document and enjoy the game!!!
